UPDATE voice_sessions SET 
  booking_context = '{{ $json.bookingContext }}'::jsonb,
  conversation_history = (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(elem) FROM (
      SELECT elem FROM jsonb_array_elements(conversation_history) AS elem
      UNION ALL
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'role', 'assistant',
        'content', '{{ $json.twiml.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ").replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0, 500) }}',
        'timestamp', NOW()::text
      )
    ) sub
  )
WHERE call_sid = '{{ $json.callSid }}';
SELECT booking_context, conversation_history FROM voice_sessions WHERE call_sid = '{{ $json.callSid }}' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO bookings (call_sid, caller_phone, event_title, event_start, event_end, event_duration_minutes, service_type, notes, google_event_id, google_calendar_id, calendar_link, status) VALUES ('{{ $json.callSid }}', '{{ $json.callerPhone }}', '{{ ($json.serviceType || "Appointment") + " - Caller " + $json.callerPhone }}', '{{ $json.eventStart }}', '{{ $json.eventEnd }}', {{ $json.duration || 60 }}, '{{ $json.serviceType || "general" }}', '{{ ($json.notes || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.googleEventId || "" }}', '{{ $json.calendarId || "primary" }}', '{{ $json.calendarLink || "" }}', 'confirmed');

UPDATE voice_sessions SET 
  booking_context = NULL,
  conversation_history = (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(elem) FROM (
      SELECT elem FROM jsonb_array_elements(conversation_history) AS elem
      UNION ALL
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'role', 'user',
        'content', '{{ $("Match Slot Selection").first().json.speechResult.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        'timestamp', NOW()::text
      )
      UNION ALL
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'role', 'assistant',
        'content', 'Appointment confirmed for {{ $json.spokenDate }} at {{ $json.spokenTime }}.',
        'timestamp', NOW()::text
      )
    ) sub
  )
WHERE call_sid = '{{ $json.callSid }}';

INSERT INTO analytics_events (event_type, channel, customer_phone, session_id, event_data) VALUES ('booking_confirmed', 'voice', '{{ $('Match Slot Selection').first().json.callerPhone }}', '{{ $('Match Slot Selection').first().json.callSid }}', '{{ JSON.stringify({ service: $('Match Slot Selection').first().json.serviceType, date: $('Match Slot Selection').first().json.bookingDate, time: $('Match Slot Selection').first().json.matchedSlot.label }).replace(/\x27/g, "''") }}'::jsonb);
